mapper.sql: select chapter_id, work_id, chapter_no, chapter_title, chapter_brief, content, word_count, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ai_novel_chapter
mapper.select: where work_id = #{workId} and del_flag = '0' order by chapter_no asc, chapter_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_novel_chapter (work_id, chapter_no, chapter_title, chapter_brief, content, word_count, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{workId}, #{chapterNo}, #{chapterTitle}, #{chapterBrief}, #{content}, #{wordCount}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update ai_novel_chapter set chapter_no = #{chapterNo}, update_time = now() where chapter_id = #{chapterId} and work_id = #{workId} and del_flag = '0'
update ai_novel_chapter set del_flag = '2', update_time = now() where chapter_id = #{chapterId} and del_flag = '0'
